postmortems.title: Discord overlay false positive spike
postmortems.summary: Discord canary build (v1.0.3) changed its overlay injection pattern, causing the kernel layer to flag it as DLL injection. ~40 sessions were falsely flagged. No auto-bans were issued (all below 95% confidence threshold). Whitelist updated within 3 hours.
postmortems.rootCause: Discord modified its overlay hook from SetWindowsHookEx to a direct IAT patch. Our kernel layer's DLL injection heuristic matched the new pattern.
postmortems.resolution: Added Discord's updated injection signature to the overlay whitelist. Deployed hotfix v0.4.2.0b-patch1.
postmortems.lessonsLearned: Need automated regression testing against top-20 overlay apps on every kernel layer update.

postmortems.title: Behavioral model latency regression
postmortems.summary: Model update bm-3.0.9 doubled inference time to 4.8ms on i5-10th gen and older CPUs. No detection failures occurred. Rolled back to bm-3.0.8, re-optimized, and redeployed as bm-3.1.0.
postmortems.rootCause: New model architecture used unsupported ONNX operator on older CPUs, falling back to CPU-only path instead of using AVX2.
postmortems.resolution: Added ONNX operator compatibility check to model validation pipeline. Re-exported model with compatible operators.
postmortems.lessonsLearned: Model deployment pipeline needs hardware-matrix benchmarking gate before rollout.

postmortems.title: Driver load failure on Windows 11 24H2 preview
postmortems.summary: Microsoft changed kernel callback registration behavior in Windows 11 24H2 preview build 26200. The Cerberus driver failed to load on affected systems (~12 beta testers). Patched in v0.4.1.7b.
postmortems.rootCause: PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx2 behavior changed in 24H2 preview, requiring updated callback registration.
postmortems.resolution: Updated driver to use version-aware callback registration with fallback to legacy API on older builds.
postmortems.lessonsLearned: Subscribe to Windows Insider kernel change notifications. Add Win11 preview builds to CI test matrix.
